text:
alice: Heads up — promote to prod failed. deploy-bot returned `artifact not found` for sha=sha256:8a7f... CI shows 404 pulling blob. Suspect cache-pruner raced with promote.

bob: Can you paste the deploy-bot error?

carol: Logs from registry and pruner:```
2026-03-21T16:03:12Z cache-pruner[worker]: deleting blobs for repo=redwood/service-x tag=canary
2026-03-21T16:03:13Z registry[http]: GET /v2/redwood/service-x/blobs/sha256:8a7f... -> 404
2026-03-21T16:03:14Z deploy-bot[promote]: promote failed: pull blob not found: sha256:8a7f...
```

ci-bot: Pipeline 68231 failed during promote step (exit code 1). Link: https://ci.redwood.internal/68231 :warning:

deploy-bot: Promotion paused by deploy-bot — manual intervention required. (started by @alice) :no_entry:

dave: If pruner deleted the blob mid-promote we have two options: rollback to previous image OR re-upload missing blobs and retry promote.

erin: Reupload looks fastest if artifact still salvageable from build cache or staging registry. Rolling back will delay feature launch for the change window.

bob: Can we temporarily disable pruner for service-x and re-run promote?

carol: We can scale down the pruner job for that repo: `kubectl scale deployment cache-pruner -n infra --replicas=0 --selector=repo=service-x` then reupload.

alice: I'm +1 to disabling pruner and reuploading. Who can reupload artifact sha256:8a7f...?

bob: I'll pull from the staging runner cache and push to registry mirror. Running: `s3 cp s3://ci-cache/68231/artifacts/service-x/sha256-8a7f.tar.gz . && crane push --tar sha256-8a7f.tar.gz registry.redwood.internal/redwood/service-x@sha256:8a7f...`

ci-bot: builder-15: started artifact push by bob.

carol: Also adding an immediate mitigation: add a promote lock so pruner skips blobs with active promote sessions. Filed quick patch: https://git.redwood/infrastructure/cache-pruner/pull/42

dave: For release notes and postmortem — we should note race between pruner TTL and promote window. Action items: disable pruner during canary->prod promo for this repo until patch lands, add instrumentation for promote lock metrics.

alice: OK doing manual hold on release. Change window still ok but we need to keep cut frozen for 30m. @bob reupload ETA?

bob: ETA ~10m to finish push and ~5m for registry to digest.

ci-bot: artifact push completed and digest available: sha256:8a7f...

deploy-bot: Received artifact digest, retrying promote.

deploy-bot: Promote succeeded :shipit: — canary -> prod promoted for service-x.

erin: Awesome. Re-enabling pruner with new lock at end of day after patch merged and deployed.

carol: Created follow-up ticket: INFRA-1284 "Add promote lock and prune-safety checks" with priority P2.

alice: Closing thread — we held cut, reuploaded, promoted successfully. Postmortem in #postmortems tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
